Sign-in, account linking, tokens, and second-factor validation.

[[file:index.org][index]] · ~16 min

* 1. resolve-social-identity!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/resolve-social-identity!
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/core.clj
:LINE: 168
:MINS: 3.2
:END:

Resolves a social sign-in to an existing identity, links it to an account with the same verified email when allowed, or creates an account. The resulting stable account ID is used for [[file:glossary.org::#term/auth][authorization]] independently of the sign-in method.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/accounts/core.clj::(defn resolve-social-identity!][src/graphden/accounts/core.clj:168]]

* 2. mint-session!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/mint-session!
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/core.clj
:LINE: 221
:MINS: 1.7
:END:

Creates a stored session whose raw token is returned once; storage keeps its SHA-256 hash. Session kinds also distinguish verification links and pending second-factor steps, which must not authenticate as ordinary API sessions.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/accounts/core.clj::(defn mint-session!][src/graphden/accounts/core.clj:221]]

* 3. accounts-provider
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/accounts-provider
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/provider.clj
:LINE: 67
:MINS: 0.9
:END:

Authenticates an API bearer token or the HttpOnly session cookie and returns an account [[file:glossary.org::#term/auth][principal]]. Organisation membership is resolved separately by the tenancy layer, so the accounts provider does not choose an organisation.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/accounts/provider.clj::(defn accounts-provider][src/graphden/accounts/provider.clj:67]]

* 4. make-router
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/make-router
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/routes.clj
:LINE: 493
:MINS: 8.7
:END:

Builds the account HTTP routes for sign-in, identity management, verification, and two-factor [[file:glossary.org::#term/auth][authentication]]. It returns nil for unhandled paths so later routers can continue. Page presentation uses an injected graph renderer with a built-in fallback when graph rendering is unavailable.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/accounts/routes.clj::(defn make-router][src/graphden/accounts/routes.clj:493]]

* 5. valid?
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/valid?
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/totp.clj
:LINE: 103
:MINS: 1.2
:END:

Validates time-based one-time passwords according to RFC 6238, allowing the adjacent time steps for clock skew and comparing codes in constant time. Reference vectors test the algorithm; account flows handle enrollment and confirmation separately.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/accounts/totp.clj::(defn valid?][src/graphden/accounts/totp.clj:103]]
